verdict.rationale: Oneleet ships automations, such as Fieldwork AI agents that collect evidence on a schedule, and agent access via MCP and service keys, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review, or rollback of those automations. URI-versioned API routes, policy draft publishing and re-adding a framework to restore its controls are related features, not automation version control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
